quarterly_data.quarter: Equinix press release: Equinix Unveils Equinix Fabric One, Redefining How (09-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Equinix announced Equinix Fabric One, a managed, any-to-any connectivity service for distributed cloud, network and AI environments: customers state the outcome they need and the service orchestrates routing, cloud connectivity, encryption, resiliency and failover. It builds on the open-source OpenAPI 3.0 Interconnect specification developed by AWS and Google Cloud, which serve as lead integration partners. Beta is expected later this year, with general availability planned for 2027, initially in North America. The exchange it runs on counts more than 10,500 interconnected businesses, approximately 3,000 cloud and IT providers, and active deployments by eight of the top 10 AI model providers and nine of the top 10 neoclouds.
quarterly_data.figure: Fabric One beta later this year; general availability planned for 2027 (North America first)
